PROCEDURES NOTE

Transcatheter aortic valve replacement was performed for severe symptomatic native aortic
stenosis via right transfemoral access under conscious sedation.

The heart team selected a balloon-expandable platform given the patient's annular
anatomy. An S3 was advanced across the native valve and deployed under rapid ventricular
pacing in good position with no more than trivial paravalvular leak on final angiography.

Implant Size: 26

Post-deployment transthoracic echocardiography prior to discharge showed the mean gradient
is 8 mmHg with a dimensionless valve index of 0.44.
